description_en: Creates a plan for an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb create-db-instance-plan --db-instance-id gp-bp12ga6v69h860000 --plan-name test-plan --plan-type PauseResume --plan-schedule-type Regular --plan-config pause_:_planCronTime_:_0_0_12_1/1_0_0_,_resume_:_planCronTime_:_0_0_0_1/1_0_0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDBInstancePlan

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the plan. Valid values:

PauseResume: pauses and resumes an instance.
Resize: changes the number of compute nodes.
ModifySpec: changes compute node specifications.

You can specify the value to ModifySpec only for instances in elastic storage mode.
You can specify the value to ModifySpec only for instances in elastic storage mode
parameters.help_zh:
计划类型，取值如下：

PauseResume：自动启停。
Resize：实例变配，即增加或减少计算节点。
ModifySpec：规格变更，即变更计算节点规格。

实例变配仅支持Serverless模式实例。
规格变更仅支持存储弹性模式实例
parameters.name: plan_type

parameters.help_en:
The execution mode of the plan. Valid values:

Postpone: The plan is executed later.
Regular: The plan is executed periodically
parameters.help_zh:
计划执行方式，取值如下：

Postpone：稍后执行。
Regular：周期执行
parameters.name: plan_schedule_type

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the plan. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.



This parameter must be specified only when PlanScheduleType is set to Regular.

If you do not specify this parameter, the current time is used
parameters.help_zh: 计划的开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 仅PlanScheduleType为Regular时需要设置该参数。 不传默认为当前时间
parameters.name: plan_start_date

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the plan. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. The end time must be later than the start time.



This parameter must be specified only when PlanScheduleType is set to Regular.

If you do not specify this parameter, the plan stops until the plan is deleted
parameters.help_zh: 计划的结束时间，需要大于查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 仅PlanScheduleType为Regular时需要设置该参数。 该参数非必填，没有结束时间，计划删除周期停止
parameters.name: plan_end_date

parameters.help_en: The execution information of the plan. Specify the parameter in the JSON format. The parameter value varies based on the values of PlanType and PlanScheduleType. The following section describes the PlanConfig parameter
parameters.help_zh: 执行计划具体信息，JSON格式，内容需根据PlanType参数和PlanScheduleType参数的值进行调整，具体说明请参见以下补充说明
parameters.name: plan_config

ErrorMessage.description_en:
The error message.

This parameter is returned only if the request fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh:
错误信息。

只会在API执行失败时返回该参数

Status.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful.

If the request was successful, success is returned. If the request failed, this parameter is not returned
Status.description_zh:
API执行状态。

执行成功则返回success；执行失败则不返回该参数
